name: autofeature
description:
Build a feature end-to-end from a single prompt — interrogate, plan, implement, test, review, ship — with requests triaged first so a question doesn't trigger a full pipeline.
Includes review lenses, live acceptance testing across web/iOS/Android, backend-standards enforcement, and a per-repo coding-pattern canon.
Plus a cross-repo Ritchies platform builder and Australian modern-award interpretation, model-tiered for cost.
